title: The move you keep holding back (dance anyway)
description:
You keep holding back the thing that's most yours.

Self-consciousness leaves inside the doing — not before.
#Shorts #poetry #creativity #authenticity
hook_visual: Text fades in on black: 'There's a move you keep holding back.' — cut to person moving alone in a warmly lit room, no visible audience.
end_screen_cta: Hold on text overlay: 'What's the move you keep waiting to make?' — two seconds, then subscribe prompt.
